outgoing.name: 15th century
outgoing.excerpt: Eleven cities conquered by Montezuma in the 15th century paid a yearly tribute of 2000 decorated cotton blankets and 40 bags of cochineal dye each.

outgoing.name: 19th century
outgoing.excerpt: After synthetic pigments and dyes such as alizarin were invented in the late 19th century, natural-dye production gradually diminished.

outgoing.name: 20th century
outgoing.excerpt: The "tuna blood" dye stopped being used and trade in cochineal almost totally disappeared in the course of the 20th century.
